meta.node_id_convention_summary: farm_manager is the legacy module: file-level api_endpoint nodes (farm_manager.api.<file>) for most routers, with per-endpoint nodes (farm_manager.api.blocks.<fn>, farm_manager.api.farms.<fn>, farm_manager.api.v1.tasks.<fn>) retained for blocks.py/farms.py/tasks.py because they already exist. Services are PascalCase class nodes (farm_manager.service.<Class>), models are per-file PascalCase nodes (farm_manager.model.<MainClass>), collections are collection_<snake>. No new granularity introduced.

farm_manager api_router (v1 mount table)

Only farms_router gets a prefix here (/farms); all other routers carry their own prefix. Also mounts two shared tool routers from src/api/v1/tools (chemicals, fertilizer_cost) under /tools. Re-exports both block_harvests routers (router + farm_router) and both block_alerts routers.

A second farm_router adds GET /farms/{farm_id}/alerts for the farm-level rollup. Models come from models/alert.py (Alert/AlertCreate/AlertResolve/AlertStatus/AlertSeverity), NOT models/block_alert.py.

nodes.name: GET /archives
nodes.description: Read-mostly analytics over archived block cycles (ArchiveService). Block scope: list archives, cycle history. Farm scope: list archives, performance analytics, crop comparison, top-performing blocks, exportable performance report. Crop scope: list crop archives, crop performance analytics. System scope: system-wide analytics and cross-crop comparison. Plus GET /{archive_id} and DELETE /{archive_id}.

nodes.name: CRUD /farms/{farm_id}/blocks/{block_id}/harvests
nodes.description: Harvest recording for a block plus a farm-level rollup, all through HarvestService. Single-line surface: POST '' (record_harvest, updates the block's actualYieldKg/totalHarvests/yieldEfficiencyPercent), GET '' (list), GET /summary, GET/PATCH/DELETE /{harvest_id}; farm_router adds GET /farms/{farm_id}/harvests. Plant Library harvest routing (2026-08) added POST /batch (submit_harvest_batch, farm.operate): a multi-line submission for one block+date where each line names a productId resolved from the block's mother (block.productMotherId -> plant_mothers.products[]) and is routed by that product's category — sellable -> block_harvests row -> inventory_harvest FIFO batch, process -> processing_inventory row, waste -> inventory_waste — with every line sharing one server-generated harvestBatchId (never client-supplied). qualityGrade is required for sellable/process lines and REJECTED (400) on waste lines. Companion GET /batch-lookup?harvestDate= (get_harvest_batch_lookup) unions all three destinations for that block+date grouped by harvestBatchId so a mixed batch can be reviewed/edited as a unit; the plain GET '' list is unchanged and stays block_harvests-only. Static routes (/batch, /batch-lookup, /summary) are declared before the dynamic /{harvest_id} route.

nodes.name: CRUD /config
nodes.description: System configuration under /config. Spacing standards: GET/PUT/POST-reset plus GET /spacing-categories and a GET plant-count calculator (ConfigService). Farming year: GET/PUT config, GET current farming year, GET farming-years list (FarmingYearService). Auth is get_current_user (any authenticated caller).

nodes.name: GET /dashboard
nodes.description: Farm dashboard aggregation. Talks to repositories directly (FarmRepository, BlockRepository, AlertRepository) plus utils/dashboard_calculator rather than to a service class, and caches responses with src.core.cache.cache_response. GET /dashboard (global summary), GET /filter-crops, GET /farms/{farm_id} (per-farm dashboard), PATCH quick-transition (fast block state change), POST quick-harvest (fast harvest entry), POST recalculate-kpi. get_recent_activity/get_upcoming_events are internal helpers, not routes.

nodes.name: POST /farms/{farm_id}/blocks/{block_id}/ai/chat
nodes.description: Block-scoped Gemini AI assistant (FarmAIChatService) with SenseHub tool execution: POST '' (chat) and POST /confirm (confirm a pending write action) — the same two-step confirmation flow used by ai_hub and farm_level_ai_chat, scoped to a single block.

nodes.name: CRUD /inventory
nodes.description: Farm inventory: the module's largest router (~3200 lines, ~50 endpoints) and the only farm_manager router that talks to MongoDB directly through motor (get_database/farm_db) instead of a service class. Covers harvest, input and asset inventory CRUD with CSV export, products CRUD, the inventory_movements ledger (record_movement), transfers, waste (list/create/summary/{id} CRUD plus POST /waste/from-harvest), expiry (POST /admin/process-expired, POST expire, POST revive), returned inventory over the inventory_returned collection plus mark-returned-as-waste, unit conversion helpers and category/status/grade enum getters. Everything is organization-scoped via get_organization_id, with farm-vs-organization scope enforced by compute_inventory_scope/validate_scope_rules. Plant Library harvest routing (2026-08) added GET /inventory/processing (list_processing_inventory) — a paginated, org-scoped read over the new processing_inventory collection filterable by farm_id/block_id/product_id, which is the read side of harvest lines routed to the 'process' product category by POST .../harvests/batch.

nodes.name: GET /managers
nodes.description: Single endpoint listing users eligible for farm assignment. Queries the users collection directly via farm_db for active users whose role carries farm.manage (manager/admin/super_admin); used to populate farm-manager pickers.

nodes.name: CRUD /plant-data
nodes.description: Legacy simple plant catalogue (PlantDataService): POST/GET/GET{id}/PATCH{id}/DELETE{id} plus POST /import-csv and GET /csv-template. Superseded by plant_data_enhanced + plant_mothers but still mounted; list reads are cached with src.core.cache.cache_response.

nodes.name: CRUD /plant-data-enhanced
nodes.description: Variety-level plant library (PlantDataEnhancedService): create, search, filter-options, active plants, get/update/delete, clone, get-by-farm-type, get-by-tags, plus CSV template/export/import. Plant Library restructure moved the CSV path onto the mother/variety model: template and POST /import-csv rows collapse onto one find-or-created MOTHER (product) keyed by motherName (via PlantMotherService), with varietyName unique within its mother; plantType/scientificName are only honoured when the mother is newly created (rename an existing mother with PATCH /plant-mothers/{id} instead), and a variety that duplicates one already under its mother is recorded and skipped rather than aborting the import. Import returns mothersCreated / mothersReused / varietiesCreated counts.

nodes.name: CRUD /farm/plant-mothers
nodes.description: Plant Library mother (product/folder) CRUD plus variety and product management, all via PlantMotherService. Mothers: POST/GET/GET{id}/PATCH{id}/DELETE{id} /plant-mothers. Varieties: GET+POST /plant-mothers/{id}/varieties. Harvest-routing product picklist (2026-08): POST+GET /plant-mothers/{id}/products and PATCH+DELETE /plant-mothers/{id}/products/{product_id} — a product's category (sellable / process / waste) is what POST /farms/{farm_id}/blocks/{block_id}/harvests/batch routes each harvest line on. Product names are unique case-insensitively within a mother, `unit` is not editable after creation, and DELETE is deactivation only (isActive=False, never removed from the list) so historical productId references need no migration. Product mutations require the 'agronomist' permission; reads require any authenticated user.

nodes.name: CRUD /plantings
nodes.description: Planting plan management (PlantingService): POST '' (create plan), POST /{planting_id}/plant (mark as planted), GET /{planting_id}, GET '' (list). Models from models/planting.py.

nodes.name: CRUD /sensehub
nodes.description: Live proxy to a block's SenseHub edge hub (SenseHubConnectionService, with SenseHubCacheQueryService as the read fallback). Connection: connect/disconnect/status. Reads: dashboard, equipment + equipment history, alerts, lab nutrients/latest/readings/stats. Writes: relay control (single + all), automation CRUD plus toggle/trigger, alert acknowledge. _is_connection_error/_handle_sensehub_error translate an unreachable hub into a clean HTTP error instead of a 500.

nodes.name: CRUD /tasks
nodes.description: Operations Task Manager router file (/tasks) — TaskService + TaskGeneratorService + HarvestAggregatorService. Individual endpoints are mapped separately as farm_manager.api.v1.tasks.* nodes; this file-level node is the router container only. v1.11.0: list/detail endpoints return FarmTaskWithDetails (block + farm + crop context).

nodes.name: GET /weather
nodes.description: Agricultural weather for a farm from WeatherBit (WeatherService + WeatherCacheService): GET current, GET forecast, GET agri-data, plus cache management — GET cache stats, POST refresh, DELETE per-farm cache invalidation. verify_farm_access resolves the farm through FarmService and gates every route on farm access.
